title: Which dex an existing position is monitored and sold on

options.name: Keep current behaviour: the first V2 or V3 dex of the chain on resume and in dashboard sells
options.risk: Positions bought on a second dex lose working exits after a restart or a dashboard sell (AUD-EXIT-013).

options.name: Use the stored dex_name; fail loud when it is missing or not configured
options.behavior_impact: Every position is always quoted and sold on its own pool.
options.risk: Old rows with a null dex_name need a one-time decision.

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides which router and pool an existing position uses.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
